title: Four-leaf clover, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description A unique design Digital printing of the highest quality Decorated with a magnifying lens Lucky charm Since time immemorial, people have sought to unravel the knowledge about happiness. The silver talisman in the form of a coin harbors reservoirs of positive energy, and the symbols enclosed under the lens favor the smile of fate. Adding it to your collection will not only make it a valuable part of your assortment but also bring a touch of joy every day. Allow yourself to experience happiness in its purest form!
